QUOTE: by default, every mbedtls allocation is a plain `calloc`/`free` from libc. ... `mbedtls_calloc(n, sz)  ──macro──>  calloc(n, sz)   (include/mbedtls/platform.h ~167)` / `mbedtls_free(p)       ──macro──>  free(p)`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off), `mbedtls_calloc` and `mbedtls_free` are macros expanding directly to `calloc` and `free`.
